document_input_unavailable: The original document inputs are no longer available. Your message is kept.

document_revision_unavailable: Document revision is not available right now. Your message is kept.
clarification_pause_pending: This conversation is preparing to continue. Keep your answer and try again shortly.
document_information_incomplete: Document planning is still incomplete. This task has stopped and no files were published. Review the unresolved questions in the answer.
document_request_rejected: The template request was not accepted. Review the request before starting a new one.
document_routing_invalid: The model's response for deciding how to use the PPTX failed validation. No proposed file action was executed. Retry the request; if it fails again, share the diagnostic reference with your admin.
document_routing_uncertain: The model could not determine how you want to use the PPTX. State whether to analyze it without changing it or edit it while preserving its layout, then send again.
document_routing_source_unavailable: The original request or its attachments changed or became unavailable while the PPTX use was being checked. The proposed file action was not executed. Check access to the original files, attach them again if needed, and resend your request.
document_history_unavailable: Earlier clarification answers cannot be safely reused for this document. No files were published. Start a new request and state the confirmed choices explicitly.
document_planning_failed: The document task could not finish. No files were published. Review the explanation for this turn.
capability_not_found: This plugin no longer exists. Refresh the plugin list.
capability_version_conflict: Someone changed this plugin after you opened it. Refresh it, review the current version, and save again.
capability_disabled: This plugin is disabled. Enable it before editing it or adding it to an Agent.
capability_name_conflict: The team already has a plugin with this name. Choose a different name.

capability_skill_unavailable: One or more selected Skills are not available as approved team Skills: they were removed, disabled, are waiting for re-approval, or are personal. Remove them from the plugin or have them approved, then save again.

capability_empty: A plugin selected for this Agent contains no tools or Skills. Remove it from the Agent or ask a team admin to add resources to it.
capability_skill_conflict: The same Skill is included with different permissions by this Agent and one of its plugins, or by two plugins. Use the same permissions everywhere or remove one of them, then try again.
capability_selection_invalid: The Agent's plugin selection is invalid (at most 32 team plugins). Reselect the plugins and save again.
capability_selection_duplicate: A plugin is selected more than once for this Agent. Remove the duplicate and save again.
capability_agent_resources_invalid: The Agent's tool or Skill list is malformed, so its plugins cannot be combined with it. Open the Agent's configuration, reselect its tools and Skills, and save again.

refresh_impact_unknown: The refresh would remove tools that this source currently provides ({tools}), and which Agents use them cannot be checked because some Agents predate versioned releases. Ask an administrator to migrate those Agents to versions, then refresh again.

resource_impact_stale: The resource or its impact changed while you were reviewing it. Review the refreshed impact and confirm again.
resource_impact_unavailable: The impact of this change could not be verified right now, so it was not applied. Try again later; if it persists, contact your administrator.
resource_command_changed: The confirmed change no longer matches this request. Preview the change again and confirm it.
resource_command_conflict: This confirmation was already used for a different change. Preview the change again and confirm it.

shopify_unreachable: Shopify could not be reached. Check the store domain and network access, then try again.
shopify_timeout: Shopify did not respond in time. Try again later.
shopify_throttled: Shopify is rate-limiting requests. Wait a minute and try again.

shopify_response_invalid: Shopify returned an unexpected response. Try again later; if it persists, contact your administrator.
